title: steps
description: Steps in order, each numbered under a line to the next, ticked once done and ringed while being done, with its tags under its title

tags.description: Short values under the title, each a line of Markdown or a pill, as a table's cells; say in it what it is, such as PR #428, and name a step by what does not change when the steps move (after #428, not after 1)
